name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
note_long: More varied than Sonnet 5.5: one dynamic carving shot, one with a motor pod. The sombreros come out as lampshades or bonnets. Run 3 called an image generator instead of writing SVG and is not shown.

note.en: Livelier than 5.5, but the sombreros look like lampshades. Run 3 called an image tool instead.
note.ru: Живее, чем 5.5, но сомбреро похожи на абажуры. Прогон 3 вызвал генератор картинок вместо SVG.
